text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before the race, Curren Bouquetd'or
is remarkably calm. She doesn't seem
to be dwelling on her last defeat.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes, actually—I ordered a bouquet
of Casablanca lilies.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The language of flowers says—"Blessing."
This is my own... declaration of resolve.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I decided that I would definitely win—and accept it
with true pride..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "That might be... the reason I'm able to stay so strong-willed right now."
choice_data_list: Let's win and accept those flowers with our heads held high!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes. Well then—I shall be on my way.
